_doc: Frozen settings for the local-vs-global knowledge evaluation (docs/plan_2026-10_priors_library_survey.md, workstream D; pre-registration in PREREGISTRATION.md). Same agent, budget and decoding in every arm; the ONLY difference is the memory block (runs/notes_<arm>.json). Generation reuses experiments/swebench/generate.py with KEL_SWEBENCH_CONFIG=<this file>. Change NOTHING after the design is frozen -- log deviations in DEVIATIONS.md.

corpus._doc: The global Kel corpus, exported ONCE to a local file (no Neon reads during the experiment). corpus.jsonl rows: gid, name, desc, proc, steps, pre, pitfalls, source, row_ref. Embeddings: BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 of 'name\ndesc', normalised.

split.rule: unseen = instance_id not in the corpus; created_at >= model_cutoff (the agent model cannot have seen the fix); the repo has >= min_history corpus Goals created strictly before the task; at most max_per_repo tasks per repo (the earliest, so later tasks never inform the choice); a stable hash order picks the scored set and the calibration set from DIFFERENT repos

arms.A0: nothing (the agent alone, real checkout at base_commit)
arms.L1: local .stealth only: claims (repo facts) + library (this repo's past fixes from git history before base_commit, with diffs)
arms.L2: L1 + enterprise-global: Kel Goals from the same GitHub org, created before the task
arms.L3: L2 + full global: Kel Goals from the whole corpus, created before the task

providers._doc: Pluggable sources for each tier. 'stub' = the deterministic stand-ins in history.py until workstream C (feat/survey) merges; switch to 'survey' then and log it in DEVIATIONS.md BEFORE building the scored notes. 'replica' = local retrieval over the exported corpus with the same embedding model find_ways uses; 'find_ways' = the real server tool (needs STEALTH_MCP_URL).

right_cause.grader: claude sonnet subagents, blind to arm, 8 tasks per batch

kel_settings._doc: Set by swe_env.py for every step. No arm calls the Kel server during generation (notes are built beforehand), so these only keep swe_env's guard consistent.
